To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the variability of the subthreshold drain-current is not correlated with threshold-voltage variability and the subthreshold slope variability.

the subthreshold variability cannot be described by the threshold voltage variability, and that the variability of the subthreshold drain leakage current in UTBB MOS devices can be described by a combination of the variability of the effective body factor, threshold voltage and gate leakage current.
the global variability in UTBB MOS transistors in subthreshold regime cannot be described by the variability of the threshold voltage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the variability in subthreshold and deep off-state of UTBB MOSFETS.
the analysis and assessment of the variability of UTBB MOSFETS in subthreshold regime.
the global variability of UTBB MOSFETS in subthreshold regime and it is shown that the subthreshold variability is not only related to threshold voltage variability but also to short channel effects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the global variability of UTBB devices is comparable to the global variability of planar bulk and fully-depleted (FD) SOI MOSFETs.
the global variability of UTBB MOSFETS in the subthreshold regime is mainly determined by the variability of the subthreshold slope and DIBL.
the variability in the UTBB MOSFETS is mainly caused by the threshold voltage variability and the variability of the subthreshold slope is mainly due to the threshold voltage variability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
variability in the subthreshold regime is dominated by the variability in the threshold voltage and the effective body factor.
the subthreshold and off regime variability of UTBB MOSFETS is dominated by the variability of the gate length.
the variability in subthreshold regime is mainly determined by the variability of the effective body factor and threshold voltage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the variability of UTBB MOSFETS in the off and subthreshold regimes is dominated by the gate oxide variability.
the variability in the off-state drain currents is dominated by the variability in the subthreshold slope.
the variability in the subthreshold drain leakage is mainly determined by the variability of the effective body factor and the threshold voltage.
